base_member_text: [L49-L63] (LOW/debug API exposure) The exported writetolog entry point is hard-coded to emit ten test messages and report success, which appears to be diagnostic scaffolding exposed as part of the shared-library ABI.
audit_member_text: [L49-L63] (LOW/production-api) A C-exported function emits the same hard-coded test message ten times, exposing apparent test scaffolding as part of the library ABI.
[L12-L38] (LOW/kind-conversion) C-int wrapper results are assigned directly from default-integer library functions without an explicit kind conversion or assertion that the kinds match.

[L33-L38] (MED/symbol-contract) This module exports the C symbol finalize with a different wrapper from xbeach_bmi.f90, so the build must keep the two objects mutually exclusive but that requirement is not expressed in the source.
[L49-L60] (HIGH/procedure-pointer) The exported writetolog test calls distributelog unconditionally even though that procedure pointer is initialized null and may never have been assigned.
